CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_product_shop_links_departmentId` ON `product_shop_links` (`departmentId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_product_shop_links_productId` ON `product_shop_links` (`productId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_product_shop_links_shopId` ON `product_shop_links` (`shopId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_products_name` ON `products` (`name`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_products_productGroupId` ON `products` (`productGroupId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_products_recipientId` ON `products` (`recipientId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_shop_departments_shopId` ON `shop_departments` (`shopId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_shopping_list_entries_assignedDepartmentId` ON `shopping_list_entries` (`assignedDepartmentId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_shopping_list_entries_assignedShopId` ON `shopping_list_entries` (`assignedShopId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_shopping_list_entries_productId` ON `shopping_list_entries` (`productId`)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `product_groups` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `displayOrder` INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `product_shop_links` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `productId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `shopId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `priority` INTEGER NOT NULL, `departmentId` INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(`productId`) REFERENCES `products`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE , FOREIGN KEY(`shopId`) REFERENCES `shops`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE , FOREIGN KEY(`departmentId`) REFERENCES `shop_departments`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE SET NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `products` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `productGroupId` INTEGER, `recipientId` INTEGER, `defaultUnit` TEXT, `defaultQuantity` REAL, `note` TEXT, `purchaseType` TEXT NOT NULL, `sellerUrl` TEXT, `productUrl` TEXT, `photoUri` TEXT, `priceValue` REAL, `priceDate` TEXT, `isTemporary` INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`productGroupId`) REFERENCES `product_groups`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE SET NULL , FOREIGN KEY(`recipientId`) REFERENCES `recipients`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE SET NULL )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `recipients` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `displayOrder` INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `shop_departments` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `shopId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `displayOrder` INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`shopId`) REFERENCES `shops`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `shopping_list_entries` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `productId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `quantity` REAL NOT NULL, `unit` TEXT NOT NULL, `assignedShopId` INTEGER, `assignedDepartmentId` INTEGER, `isBought` INTEGER NOT NULL, `isUrgent` INTEGER NOT NULL, `note` TEXT, `comment` TEXT, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`productId`) REFERENCES `products`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE , FOREIGN KEY(`assignedShopId`) REFERENCES `shops`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE SET NULL , FOREIGN KEY(`assignedDepartmentId`) REFERENCES `shop_departments`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE SET NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `shops` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `address` TEXT, `note` TEXT, `displayOrder` INTEGER NOT NULL, `showUrgentInCollapsed` INTEGER, `boostUrgentShop` INTEGER, `manualOrderOverride` INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `units` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `displayOrder` INTEGER NOT NULL)
